name: Hamilton / Toronto Express
description: The Hamilton–Union express has QEW bus predecessors; numbered route 16 is firmly documented in original early-2000 s schedules.

timeline.event: Hamilton–Toronto highway express operation transitioned from Gray Coach into GO during GO’s first bus-service year.
The Hamilton express adopted a Gardiner / University Avenue downtown approach.
Hamilton bus service moved into the new Hamilton GO Centre.
Route 16 is documented between Hamilton GO Centre and Union with direction-specific Hamilton street stops.
The timetable retains Hamilton GO Centre and Union as the express terminal pair.

sources.title: 50 Years of GO Transit Bus Operations — historical chronology by Adam Zhelka / Toronto Transportation Society
